span.span: Executable rubrics for 3 dimensions “cogency”, “local acceptability” and “global sufficiency”

span.class: ltx_listing ltx_lst_language_python ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing

span.span: "Argument has enough length to develop a line of reasoning."
"Argument is too short to establish strong cogency."
"No clear conclusion or stance is identifiable."
"Multiple premise or support markers are present."
"At least one premise marker is present."
"Logical links between premises and conclusion are explicit."
"Logical relation between support and conclusion is weakly signaled."
"Argument appears connected to the issue in the query."
"Argument appears weakly connected to the issue in the query."
"Argument may rely on repetitive or circular reasoning."
"Argument anticipates at least one objection or tradeoff."
"Argument contains explicit rebuttal or balancing language."
"Argument contains some rebuttal or balancing language."
"Rebuttal or overall argument has evidence-like support."
"Argument reaches an overall conclusion after support."
"Argument could better handle exceptions with qualification."
"Argument has enough development for global sufficiency."
"Argument is too short for global sufficiency."
"Too many absolute claims weaken sufficiency against objections."
"Premises include at least one evidence-like support."
"Premises are mostly unsupported by evidence markers."
"Premises are developed with non-trivial lexical variety."
"Argument uses broad absolute claims that may be unacceptable."
